observations: Two car headlight assemblies are shown side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with clear lenses and internal reflectors.
The top headlight has a circular projector lens and a smaller rectangular LED section, while the bottom one has a more complex arrangement with multiple LED sections.
The housing is black plastic with visible mounting points and electrical connectors.
There is a watermark 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.
No visible branding or model identifiers are readable on the headlights themselves.
The condition appears clean and undamaged from this angle, but no close-up of the glass or internal components is provided.

claims.claim: All Mazda genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used ones.
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlights to confirm they are Mazda parts. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be genuine Mazda parts, or may be from a different brand or model.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the headlight housing showing any brand name, model number, or part number, or a photo of the part number on the back or side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-genuine parts, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The headlights may be damaged internally or have cracked lenses not visible in the current photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens surface and internal reflectors, showing no cracks, scratches, or fogging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The headlights may not fit the intended vehicle model or may be incompatible.
risks.proof: A photo showing the part number or a matching part number from the vehicle's VIN or service manual.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified fit, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate under the hood or on the driver's side door pillar.
Close-up photo of the headlight housing showing any brand or model markings.
Photo of the part number or serial number on the back or side of the headlight assembly.
Close-up of the lens and internal components to check for cracks or damage.
Photo showing the headlight installed on a vehicle or with a matching part number.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
